b2-14-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Arriving at the Station
b2-14-01.scenario: A friend asks you, the narrator, what you felt when you arrived at the falconry station.
b2-14-01.prompt: Tell your friend what you felt the moment you arrived.
b2-14-01.target: Amint megérkeztem a telepre, azonnal megcsapott a feszült csend.
b2-14-01.english: As soon as I arrived at the station, the tense silence immediately struck me.
b2-14-01.canDo: I can link sudden sequential actions using amint and mihelyt.

b2-14-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Things at Once
b2-14-02.scenario: A friend asks you, the narrator, what you did while Lilik was working with the birds.
b2-14-02.prompt: Tell your friend what you did while the master worked.
cues: Say what you did at the same time
b2-14-02.target: Miközben a mester dolgozott, én figyeltem.
b2-14-02.english: While the master was working, I was watching.
b2-14-02.canDo: I can depict simultaneous actions unfolding in parallel using miközben and mialatt.

b2-14-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Silence on the Plain
b2-14-03.scenario: A friend asks you, the narrator, what happened on the plain each time the falcon took flight.
b2-14-03.prompt: Tell your friend what happened every time the falcon took flight.
cues: Say what became of the sound
b2-14-03.target: Valahányszor a sólyom felszáll, csend lesz a pusztán.
b2-14-03.english: Whenever the falcon takes flight, there is silence over the plain.
b2-14-03.canDo: I can describe recurring visual motifs using valahányszor and ahányszor csak.

b2-14-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Hood
b2-14-04.scenario: A friend asks you, the narrator, what the hood and the flying bird mean to you.
b2-14-04.prompt: Tell your friend what the bird and the hood mean, in one sentence.
cues: Say what the bird's flight means
b2-14-04.target: A sólyom röpte a szabadság jelképe, miközben a szemellenző a rabság jelképe.
b2-14-04.english: The flight of the falcon is a symbol of freedom, while the hood is a symbol of captivity.
b2-14-04.canDo: I can combine complex temporal subordinate clauses with symbolic interpretation.

b2-14-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Short Review
b2-14-05.scenario: A friend asks you to write two sentences of a review of a film you have just seen.
b2-14-05.prompt: Write a short review of the film in two sentences.
cues: Say what the viewer does when the film ends
b2-14-05.target: A rendezés hatásos. Amint véget ér a film, a néző még percekig a helyén marad.
b2-14-05.english: The direction is effective. As soon as the film ends, the viewer stays in his seat for minutes.
b2-14-05.canDo: I can write a sophisticated critical review of a film, play, or visual artwork.

b2-14-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Bird Leaves the Hand
b2-14-consolidation.scenario: A friend asks you, the narrator, what happened the moment the bird left the master's hand.
b2-14-consolidation.prompt: Tell your friend what happened right after the bird left the master's hand.
b2-14-consolidation.target: Alighogy elhagyta a madár a mester kezét, máris a magasba emelkedett.
b2-14-consolidation.english: Scarcely had the bird left the master's hand when it was already rising into the air.
b2-14-consolidation.canDo: I can link immediate sequences using amint, mihelyt, and alighogy... máris.
